title: Integrate HuntScene with HuntRoundLoop adapter path
description: Ongoing ExecPlan slice. Rework src/scenes/HuntScene.ts so it translates InputManager input into HuntRoundLoop commands, renders from HuntSnapshot, and bridges Hunt emissions back into the existing HUD/render/event flow.
acceptance_criteria: The Dense Jungle Hunt still plays in the browser, but HuntScene no longer owns the plan/submit cadence directly; it uses HuntRoundLoop as the source of truth for early round state.
notes:
Actively continuing this ExecPlan slice. Next change is to route HuntScene through HuntRoundLoop as the source of truth for plan/submit cadence and telegraph state.
Implemented the first adapter bridge: HuntScene now submits planned actions through HuntRoundLoop and reads telegraph plus plan/submit/resolve phase changes from loop emissions. Remaining work is browser validation and moving attack/dodge QTE ownership behind the loop.

title: Move resolve, QTE, stagger, scoring, and Cave Bar handoff behind HuntRoundLoop
description: Follow-on ExecPlan slice. Deepen src/logic/HuntRoundLoop.ts until it owns resolve ordering, attack and dodge QTE state, stagger windows, scoring, dinosaur health, player damage, and Hunt-end handoff.
acceptance_criteria: A Phaser-free HuntRoundLoop test can drive a complete round through resolve and QTE behavior, and HuntScene no longer coordinates those rule decisions itself.
notes: Blocked until the HuntScene adapter path lands and the scene is reading HuntRoundLoop state instead of coordinating the early cadence directly.

title: Scaffold Phaser-free HuntRoundLoop seam and ExecPlan
description: Completed milestone from docs/plans/2026-05-02-hunt-round-loop-extraction-execplan.md. Added CONTEXT.md, the checked-in ExecPlan, src/logic/HuntRoundLoop.ts, and tests/logic/HuntRoundLoop.test.ts. Landed in commit 69b4345.
acceptance_criteria: Pure logic tests can begin a Hunt, observe a telegraph, submit planned actions, and advance through the early round phases without Phaser.
close_reason: Completed in commit 69b4345: added CONTEXT.md, the HuntRoundLoop scaffold, focused tests, and the checked-in ExecPlan.
